board: Winsen ZH03B laser dust module with 8-pin 1.25 mm cable
reason: Modelled from the Winsen ZH03B manual V2.1: initiative-upload 24-byte frame 42 4D 00 14 + nine 16-bit fields (PM1.0/PM2.5/PM10 in fields 4-6, ug/m3) + 16-bit sum of bytes 1-22, streamed once a second at 9600 baud, plus Q&A and dormant replies; driver resyncs and verifies checksums. Pin order 1-8 (VDD, GND, NC, RXD, TXD, NC, NC, PWM) from the manual's pin table; cabled because the connector is 1.25 mm. Part check printed PASS on ESP32 and Pico.
breakoutPinoutSource: Winsen ZH03B manual V2.1, Table 2 'Pins definition' and Fig 1/2 (8x1.25 connector), https://www.winsen-sensor.com/d/files/ZH03B.pdf; https://www.winsen-sensor.com/product/zh03b.html
